decisions.reason: It remains a core drainage-engineering component that supports the firm's modular system business, so an established German specialist would be more likely to retain than withdraw it.
As the design-led flagship shower drainage line that closely matches the firm's strategic direction, it is very unlikely to be taken off the market within the next year.
The integrated sloped shower element strengthens installation ease and renovation suitability, which fits the firm's positioning and makes continued marketing the more probable choice.
